# Better Stack

Better Stack provides monitoring, logging, and incident management solutions to help teams ensure the reliability and performance of their applications.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/better-stack/.

## Actions

- **Create Escalation Policy**: Create a new escalation policy.
- **Create Heartbeat Group**: Create a new heartbeat group.
- **Create Outgoing Webhook Integration**: Create a new outgoing webhook integration.
- **Create Source Group**: Create a new source group.
- **Delete Escalation Policy**: Delete an escalation policy by id.
- **Delete Source Group**: Delete a source group by id.
- **Get Heartbeat**: Get a single heartbeat by id.
- **Get Heartbeat Availability**: Retrieve availability summary for a specific heartbeat.
- **Get Monitor**: Get a single monitor.
- **Get Monitor Availability**: Return an availability summary for a specific monitor.
- **Get Monitor Response Times**: Return response times for a specific monitor.
- **Get Status Page**: Get a single status page by id.
- **Get Telemetry API Token**: Retrieve the telemetry api token from the integration configuration.
- **Get Uptime API Token**: Retrieve the configured uptime api token.
- **List Catalog Relations**: List all catalog relations.
- **List Google Monitoring Integrations**: List all google monitoring integrations.
- **List Grafana Integrations**: List all grafana integrations.
- **List Heartbeats**: List all heartbeats.
- **List Monitors**: List all monitors.
- **List New Relic Integrations**: List new relic integrations.
- **List On-Call Schedules**: List all on-call schedules.
- **List Status Page Reports**: List all reports on a status page.
- **List Status Pages**: List all your status pages.
- **Update Heartbeat**: Update an existing heartbeat configuration.
- **Update Heartbeat Group**: Update an existing heartbeat group.
- **Update Source Group**: Update an existing source group.
